_meta.note: soft + blueprint + clarity + soft-utility + aurora + iris + sketch-style 七套主题

extra_css:
:root[data-theme='dark']:not([data-style]) .style-fx::before,
:root[data-theme='dark'][data-style='soft'] .style-fx::before { opacity: 0.28; }

:root[data-theme='dark']:not([data-style]) .style-fx::after,
:root[data-theme='dark'][data-style='soft'] .style-fx::after { opacity: 0.24; }
[data-style='blueprint'] .style-fx::after { content: none; }
[data-style='blueprint'] .card .icon.has-img { box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='blueprint'] .card { position: relative; }
[data-style='clarity'] .style-fx::after { content: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .style-fx { background-color: var(--bg-grad); background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%22140%22 height=%22140%22%3E%3Cfilter id=%22p%22%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%22fractalNoise%22 baseFrequency=%220.85%22 numOctaves=%224%22 stitchTiles=%22stitch%22/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%22140%22 height=%22140%22 filter=%22url(%23p)%22 opacity=%220.07%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(44,44,44,0.045) 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(44,44,44,0.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 11px); }

[data-theme='dark'][data-style='sketch-style'] .style-fx { background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%22140%22 height=%22140%22%3E%3Cfilter id=%22p%22%3E%3CfeTurbulence type=%22fractalNoise%22 baseFrequency=%220.85%22 numOctaves=%224%22 stitchTiles=%22stitch%22/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width=%22140%22 height=%22140%22 filter=%22url(%23p)%22 opacity=%220.10%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'), repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(236,229,216,0.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px), repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgba(236,229,216,0.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 11px); }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .glass, [data-style='sketch-style'] .glass-strong { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--raised); backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .glass:hover, [data-style='sketch-style'] .glass-strong:hover { transform: none; box-shadow: var(--raised); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .topbar { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .topbar-fab { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: transparent; color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--raised-sm); }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .icon-btn { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: transparent; color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--raised-sm); transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out, rotate 120ms ease-out; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); transform: none; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .icon-btn:active { rotate: -3deg; translate: 1px 1px; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .clock-time { font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--text); text-shadow: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .clock-date { font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-style: italic; color: var(--text-muted); letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding-bottom: 6px; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2216%22 height=%226%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M0 3.5 Q 4 0.5 8 3.5 T 16 3.5%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%232c2c2c%22 stroke-width=%221.5%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'); background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: left bottom; background-size: 16px 6px; }

[data-theme='dark'][data-style='sketch-style'] .clock-date { background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2216%22 height=%226%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M0 3.5 Q 4 0.5 8 3.5 T 16 3.5%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%23d9d0c0%22 stroke-width=%221.5%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--raised); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--sh-dark); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box input { background: transparent; font-family: var(--sk-hand); }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box .search-btn { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--raised-sm); transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out, rotate 120ms ease-out; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box .search-btn:hover { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .search-box .search-btn:active { rotate: -2deg; translate: 1px 1px; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .group { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); background: transparent; box-shadow: none; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .group:hover { border-color: var(--edge); box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .group-head h2 { font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding-bottom: 7px; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2216%22 height=%226%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M0 3.5 Q 4 0.5 8 3.5 T 16 3.5%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%232c2c2c%22 stroke-width=%221.5%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'); background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: left bottom; background-size: 18px 6px; }

[data-theme='dark'][data-style='sketch-style'] .group-head h2 { background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2216%22 height=%226%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M0 3.5 Q 4 0.5 8 3.5 T 16 3.5%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%23d9d0c0%22 stroke-width=%221.5%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E'); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .group-head .desc { font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-style: italic; color: var(--text-muted); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .group-add-btn { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); background: transparent; color: var(--text); box-shadow: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .card { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--raised-sm); transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out, rotate 120ms ease-out, translate 120ms ease-out; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:nth-child(3n+1) { rotate: -0.35deg; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:nth-child(3n+2) { rotate: 0.3deg; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:hover { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 var(--sh-dark); translate: -1px -1px; rotate: -0.8deg; transform: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:hover .info .t, [data-style='sketch-style'] .card:hover .info .d { color: var(--bg-grad); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:hover .icon { border-color: var(--bg-grad); color: var(--bg-grad); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card:active { rotate: 1.1deg; translate: 1px 1px; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .card .icon { width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; border: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); color: var(--text); box-shadow: none; font-family: var(--sk-hand); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .card .icon.has-img { background: var(--surface-2); border: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .btn { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: transparent; color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--raised-sm); font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out, rotate 120ms ease-out; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .btn:hover { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .btn:active { rotate: -1.2deg; translate: 1px 1px; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .btn-primary { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); border-color: var(--edge); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--text); color: var(--bg-grad); }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .input, [data-style='sketch-style'] .select, [data-style='sketch-style'] .textarea { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: var(--surface-2); font-family: var(--sk-hand); box-shadow: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .input:focus, [data-style='sketch-style'] .select:focus, [data-style='sketch-style'] .textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--sh-dark); outline: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .nm-face { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .nm-item.active .nm-face { background: var(--edge); border-color: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); box-shadow: none; }

[data-style='sketch-style'] .group-nav, [data-style='sketch-style'] .engine-menu, [data-style='sketch-style'] .card-context-menu, [data-style='sketch-style'] .search-history-dropdown, [data-style='sketch-style'] .modal-box, [data-style='sketch-style'] .toast { border-radius: 3px; border: 2px dashed var(--edge); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: var(--raised-lg); backdrop-filter: none; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] h1, [data-style='sketch-style'] h2, [data-style='sketch-style'] h3 { font-family: var(--sk-hand); font-style: italic; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] a { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-decoration-style: dashed; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .badge, [data-style='sketch-style'] .lan-badge, [data-style='sketch-style'] .hidden-badge { border-radius: 2px; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] :focus-visible { outline: 2px dashed var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] ::selection { background: var(--edge); color: var(--bg-grad); }
[data-style='sketch-style'] ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--scroll-thumb); border-radius: 0; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] .divider, [data-style='sketch-style'] hr { height: 0; border: none; border-top: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); background: none; }
[data-style='sketch-style'] table th, [data-style='sketch-style'] table td { border-bottom: 2px dashed var(--edge-weak); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { [data-style='sketch-style'] *, [data-style='sketch-style'] *::before, [data-style='sketch-style'] *::after { animation: none !important; transition-duration: 1ms !important; rotate: 0deg !important; translate: none !important; } }

[data-style='soft-utility'] .style-fx::before,
[data-style='soft-utility'] .style-fx::after { content: none; }
